learning_outcomes.text: He/she knows the number sets and functions.
He/she can investigate limit and continuity of functions.
He/she knows differentiation and differentiation rules.
He/she can use derivative in different application areas.
He/she can sketch the graph of a function with the help of its derivative.

syllabus_topics: Functions and their graphics, Trigonometric functions.
Derivative of Trigonometric Functions, Implicit Differentiation, Related rates, Derivative of Inverse Functions
Derivative of Logarithmic and Exponential Functions, Derivative of hyperbolic and inverse hyperbolic functions
He/she should revise the previous week, should read the week's subject from the lecture materials, should solve exercises given in the previous week.
Theorems Related with Differentiable Functions, Concavity, Sketching Graphs of Functions
Sketching Graphs of Functions (continued), Indeterminant Forms, L'Hopital Rule, Differentials
